from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoRatioLCV(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大，decay=0.85偏重近期
        decay = 0.85
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)
        # 预计算L2的rank权重：对n=42个排序统计量
        # β1 = sum_{j=0}^{n-1} (j/(n-1)) * x_sorted[j] / n
        # L2 = 2*β1 - β0
        n_bars = 42
        # rank weight for β1: j/(n-1)/n, j=0..n-1
        j = np.arange(n_bars, dtype=np.float64)  # [0, 1, ..., 41]
        # β1 weight: j/(n-1)/n，归一化因子已包含
        self._beta1_w = j / (float(n_bars - 1) * n_bars)  # shape [42], sum = 0.5*(n-1)/n ≈ 0.5
        self._n_bars = n_bars

    def generate(self, di):
        day = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return
        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))

        # 取过去lookback天的5m成交额数据，有效bar索引1:43，共42根
        amo_w = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)  # [L, 42, n_valid]
        L = amo_w.shape[0]

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            a = amo_w[i]  # [42, n_valid]
            # 检查每只股票的有效性：所有bar均为正且有限
            all_valid = np.all((a > 0) & np.isfinite(a), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            if not np.any(all_valid):
                continue

            # 计算amo_ratio：每根bar占全天总成交额的比例
            day_total = np.sum(a[:, all_valid], axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_good]
            ok_total = day_total[0] > 1e-10  # [n_good]

            if not np.any(ok_total):
                continue

            # 只处理有效股票
            idx_good = np.where(all_valid)[0]  # 在n_valid中的索引
            a_good = a[:, all_valid]  # [42, n_good]
            tot = day_total[0, ok_total]  # [n_ok]
            a_ok = a_good[:, ok_total]  # [42, n_ok]
            idx_ok = idx_good[ok_total]  # 在n_valid中的索引

            # amo_ratio: [42, n_ok]
            ratio = a_ok / tot[np.newaxis, :]  # [42, n_ok]

            # L-mean (L1 = mean)
            l1 = np.mean(ratio, axis=0)  # [n_ok]

            # L-scale (L2) via PWM:
            # β0 = mean(ratio) = l1
            # β1 = sum_j (j/(n-1)) * ratio_sorted[j] / n
            # L2 = 2*β1 - β0
            # 对每只股票排序后计算
            ratio_sorted = np.sort(ratio, axis=0)  # [42, n_ok]，升序
            # self._beta1_w shape [42]，beta1 = sum(w * ratio_sorted, axis=0)
            beta1 = np.sum(self._beta1_w[:, np.newaxis] * ratio_sorted, axis=0)  # [n_ok]
            l2 = 2.0 * beta1 - l1  # [n_ok]

            # L-CV = L2 / L1，需要 L1 > 0 和 L2 > 0
            l1_ok = l1 > 1e-10
            l2_ok = l2 > 0
            valid_lcv = l1_ok & l2_ok

            lcv = np.full(len(idx_ok), np.nan)
            lcv[valid_lcv] = l2[valid_lcv] / l1[valid_lcv]

            daily_stat[i, idx_ok] = lcv

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        weights = self._weights  # [L]
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)  # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        w = weights[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w * valid_mask.astype(np.float64), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面 z-score 取负
        finite = np.isfinite(mean)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return
        vals = mean[finite]
        mu_x = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return

        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals - mu_x) / std_x  # 截面z-score取负
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        self.min_valid_days = 5

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取有效bar：原始索引1:43，共42根，shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_w = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            amo_day = amo_w[i]  # shape [42, n_valid]

            # 检查每支股票是否所有bar的amo都有效
            amo_valid = np.all(np.isfinite(amo_day) & (amo_day >= 0), axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            if not np.any(amo_valid):
                continue

            # 计算amo_ratio：每天各bar成交额占全天总额的比例
            amo_sum = np.sum(amo_day, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            valid_sum = amo_valid & (amo_sum > 1e-10)

            if not np.any(valid_sum):
                continue

            # amo_ratio shape: [42, n_valid_sum]
            ratio = amo_day[:, valid_sum] / amo_sum[np.newaxis, valid_sum]  # [42, n_valid_sum]

            # 计算IQR/Range
            # 对42个ratio值排序（沿axis=0），取Q1(25%), Q3(75%), min, max
            # 使用np.sort + 线性插值分位数
            n_bars = 42
            sorted_ratio = np.sort(ratio, axis=0)  # [42, n_valid_sum]

            # Q1: 25th percentile index = (42-1)*0.25 = 10.25 -> interpolate between index 10 and 11
            q1_idx_low  = 10
            q1_idx_high = 11
            q1_frac     = 0.25
            Q1 = sorted_ratio[q1_idx_low] * (1 - q1_frac) + sorted_ratio[q1_idx_high] * q1_frac

            # Q3: 75th percentile index = (42-1)*0.75 = 30.75 -> interpolate between index 30 and 31
            q3_idx_low  = 30
            q3_idx_high = 31
            q3_frac     = 0.75
            Q3 = sorted_ratio[q3_idx_low] * (1 - q3_frac) + sorted_ratio[q3_idx_high] * q3_frac

            IQR   = Q3 - Q1                           # [n_valid_sum]
            Range = sorted_ratio[-1] - sorted_ratio[0]  # [n_valid_sum], max - min

            # IQR/Range：Range为0的情况（所有bar成交额相同）设为nan
            range_ok = Range > 1e-12
            iqr_range = np.where(range_ok, IQR / np.where(range_ok, Range, 1.0), np.nan)

            tmp[valid_sum] = iqr_range
            daily_stat[i] = tmp

        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)

            return

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangMornAmoKendallTau(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，decay=0.85偏重最近
        decay = 0.85
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)
        # 上午段bar数：有效bar相对索引0-23，共24根
        self._n_morn = 24
        # 预计算Kendall-tau分母：上午段24根，相邻对数 = 23
        self._n_pairs = float(self._n_morn - 1)  # 23.0

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))

        # 取有效5m成交额数据：[L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_w = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)
        # shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        L = amo_w.shape[0]

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            # 当天42根bar的成交额，shape: [42, n_valid]
            amo_day = amo_w[i]  # [42, n_valid]

            # 检查数据有效性：所有bar成交额必须 > 0
            ok = np.all(amo_day > 0, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            if not np.any(ok):
                continue

            # 上午段：前24根bar，shape: [24, n_valid]
            morn = amo_day[:self._n_morn, :]  # [24, n_valid]

            # 计算上午段每天的总成交额，归一化为amo_ratio
            morn_sum = np.sum(morn, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_valid]
            valid_sum = morn_sum[0] > 1e-10  # [n_valid]
            ok_i = ok & valid_sum  # [n_valid]

            if not np.any(ok_i):
                continue

            # 对ok_i股票计算amo_ratio_morn
            ratio = np.where(
                ok_i[np.newaxis, :],
                morn / np.where(morn_sum > 1e-10, morn_sum, np.ones_like(morn_sum)),
                np.nan
            )  # [24, n_valid]

            # 计算Kendall-tau：相邻对的符号差
            # tau = sum(sign(ratio[t+1] - ratio[t])) / (n_morn - 1), t=0..22
            # 即上升次数 - 下降次数 除以总对数
            diff = ratio[1:, :] - ratio[:-1, :]  # [23, n_valid]
            # 符号：+1上升，-1下降，0不变（视为0）
            sign_diff = np.sign(diff)  # [23, n_valid]
            # tau = mean(sign_diff)，range [-1, 1]
            tau = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
            n_pairs = self._n_pairs
            tau_sum = np.nansum(
                np.where(np.isfinite(sign_diff), sign_diff, 0.0),
                axis=0
            )  # [n_valid]
            n_finite = np.sum(np.isfinite(sign_diff), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            valid_tau = ok_i & (n_finite >= 10)  # 至少10对有效
            tau[valid_tau] = tau_sum[valid_tau] / n_pairs

            daily_stat[i] = tau

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        weights = self._weights  # shape [L]
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)  # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        w = weights[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w * valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面z-score取负
        finite = np.isfinite(mean)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return
        vals = mean[finite]
        mu_x = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return
        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals - mu_x) / std_x  # 取负：上午成交额单调递增→次日反转
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoRatioTrimKurt(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 10))
        except:
            self.lookback = 10
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大
        self.decay = 0.85
        # 截断比例：首尾各10% -> 42 * 0.10 = 4.2，取4根
        self.trim_k = 4  # 每端去掉4根，保留34根
        self.n_bars = 42
        self.n_trim = self.n_bars - 2 * self.trim_k  # 34
        self.min_valid_days = max(3, self.lookback // 3)

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取5m成交额数据: [L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_w = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            amo_day = amo_w[i]  # [42, n_valid]

            # 检查有效性：所有bar成交额>0且有限
            valid_bar = np.all((amo_day > 0) & np.isfinite(amo_day), axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            if not np.any(valid_bar):
                continue

            # 对有效股票计算amo_ratio
            amo_valid = amo_day[:, valid_bar]  # [42, n_valid_bar]
            amo_sum = np.sum(amo_valid, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_valid_bar]

            # 防止分母为0
            ok_sum = amo_sum[0] > 1e-10  # [n_valid_bar]

            # 初始化结果
            s = np.full(np.sum(valid_bar), np.nan)

            if np.any(ok_sum):
                ratio = amo_valid[:, ok_sum] / amo_sum[:, ok_sum]  # [42, n_ok]

                # 对每股，对ratio序列排序后截断首尾各trim_k根
                # ratio shape: [42, n_ok]
                sorted_ratio = np.sort(ratio, axis=0)  # [42, n_ok]，升序

                # 截断：保留索引[trim_k : 42-trim_k] = [4:38]，共34根
                trimmed = sorted_ratio[self.trim_k : self.n_bars - self.trim_k, :]  # [34, n_ok]

                # 计算截断超额峰度
                n_t = self.n_trim  # 34
                mu = np.mean(trimmed, axis=0)  # [n_ok]
                d  = trimmed - mu[np.newaxis, :]  # [34, n_ok]
                var = np.mean(d ** 2, axis=0)  # [n_ok]

                ok_var = var > 1e-15
                m4 = np.mean(d ** 4, axis=0)  # [n_ok]

                kurt = np.full(np.sum(ok_sum), np.nan)
                kurt[ok_var] = m4[ok_var] / (var[ok_var] ** 2) - 3.0

                s[ok_sum] = kurt

            # 填回 daily_stat
            valid_bar_idx = np.where(valid_bar)[0]
            daily_stat[i, valid_bar_idx] = s

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        weights = np.array([self.decay ** (L - 1 - i) for i in range(L)], dtype=np.float64)
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)  # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        w = weights[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w * valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面z-score取负
        finite = np.isfinite(mean)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return

        vals = mean[finite]
        mu_x  = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return

        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals - mu_x) / std_x  # 截面z-score取负
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangGapAutocorrAmoWtd(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.open_5m   = dr.getData('Interval5m.open').data  # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        self.close_5m  = dr.getData('Interval5m.close').data # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大
        decay = 0.9
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        # 信号数组：对每个valid股票，计算lookback天的加权amo-wtd gap自相关
        signal = np.zeros(n_valid, dtype=np.float64)

        for d_off in range(self.lookback):
            d = start + d_off
            w_d = self._weights[d_off]

            # 有效bar：原始索引1:43，共42根，相对索引0~41
            # open[t] 和 close[t] 的原始索引为1..42
            # bar间跳空：gap[t] = open[t+1] - close[t]，t=0..40（相对索引），共41个
            # 原始索引：open[2..43]-close[1..42] -> open_5m[d, 2:43] - close_5m[d, 1:42]
            o_all = self.open_5m[d, :, :]   # [49, n_stocks]
            c_all = self.close_5m[d, :, :]  # [49, n_stocks]
            a_all = self.amo_5m[d, :, :]    # [49, n_stocks]

            # 有效bar相对索引0~41 对应原始索引1~42
            # gap[t] = open[t+1,orig] - close[t,orig], t_rel=0..40
            # open[t+1,orig] = open_5m[d, t_rel+2], close[t,orig] = close_5m[d, t_rel+1]
            gap = o_all[2:43, :][:, valid_idx] - c_all[1:42, :][:, valid_idx]  # [41, n_valid]

            # amo权重：取相邻bar的平均amo作为gap[t]的权重
            # gap[t]对应bar t和bar t+1，amo_weight[t] = (amo[t,orig] + amo[t+1,orig]) / 2
            # amo原始索引：amo[t,orig]=amo_5m[d,t_rel+1], amo[t+1,orig]=amo_5m[d,t_rel+2]
            amo_t   = a_all[1:42, :][:, valid_idx]  # [41, n_valid], bar t
            amo_tp1 = a_all[2:43, :][:, valid_idx]  # [41, n_valid], bar t+1
            amo_w   = (amo_t + amo_tp1) * 0.5       # [41, n_valid]

            # 归一化权重（日内加和为1）
            amo_sum = amo_w.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_valid]
            amo_sum = np.where(amo_sum > 0, amo_sum, 1.0)
            amo_w_norm = amo_w / amo_sum  # [41, n_valid]

            # 计算amo加权的lag-1 gap自相关
            # 对gap[0..40]，lag-1对为 (gap[t], gap[t+1])，t=0..39，共40对
            gap_t   = gap[:40, :]   # [40, n_valid]
            gap_tp1 = gap[1:, :]    # [40, n_valid]

            # amo权重对齐：取相邻对的几何均值权重
            w_t   = amo_w_norm[:40, :]  # [40, n_valid]
            w_tp1 = amo_w_norm[1:, :]   # [40, n_valid]
            pair_w = np.sqrt(w_t * w_tp1 + 1e-30)  # [40, n_valid]
            pair_w_sum = pair_w.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)
            pair_w_sum = np.where(pair_w_sum > 0, pair_w_sum, 1.0)
            pair_w_n = pair_w / pair_w_sum  # [40, n_valid]

            # 加权均值
            wtd_mean_t   = (pair_w_n * gap_t).sum(axis=0)    # [n_valid]
            wtd_mean_tp1 = (pair_w_n * gap_tp1).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            # 加权协方差 / 加权标准差
            dev_t   = gap_t   - wtd_mean_t[np.newaxis, :]    # [40, n_valid]
            dev_tp1 = gap_tp1 - wtd_mean_tp1[np.newaxis, :]  # [40, n_valid]

            wtd_cov  = (pair_w_n * dev_t * dev_tp1).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            wtd_var_t   = (pair_w_n * dev_t   ** 2).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            wtd_var_tp1 = (pair_w_n * dev_tp1 ** 2).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            denom = np.sqrt(wtd_var_t * wtd_var_tp1)  # [n_valid]
            valid_corr = denom > 1e-12
            day_corr = np.where(valid_corr, wtd_cov / (denom + 1e-30), 0.0)  # [n_valid]

            signal += w_d * day_corr

        # 截面 z-score，取负（高自相关=追涨资金持续，次日反转）
        sig_mean = np.nanmean(signal)
        sig_std  = np.nanstd(signal)
        if sig_std < 1e-12:
            return
        zscore = -(signal - sig_mean) / sig_std

        # 写入 self.data
        valid_positions = np.where(valid_idx)[0]
        for i, pos in enumerate(valid_positions):
            self.data[di, pos] = zscore[i]

import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoPriceSync(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.close_5m  = dr.getData('Interval5m.close').data # [days, 49, n_stocks]

        try:

        except:

        decay = 0.9
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))

        # 取5分钟数据：shape [L, 42, n_valid]

        amo_w   = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)    # [L, 42, n_valid]
        L = close_w.shape[0]

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            c   = close_w[i]   # [42, n_valid]
            amo = amo_w[i]     # [42, n_valid]

            # 有效性检查：close必须>0，amo必须>0
            c_ok   = np.all(c > 0, axis=0)    # [n_valid]
            amo_ok = np.all(amo > 0, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            ok     = c_ok & amo_ok            # [n_valid]

            if not np.any(ok):
                continue

            c_ok_data   = c[:, ok]    # [42, n_ok]
            amo_ok_data = amo[:, ok]  # [42, n_ok]

            # 计算amo_ratio：每根bar成交额占全天总成交额的比例
            amo_sum = np.sum(amo_ok_data, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_ok]
            valid_day_ok = (amo_sum > 1e-10).squeeze(axis=0)       # [n_ok]

            amo_ratio = np.where(
                amo_sum > 1e-10,
                amo_ok_data / amo_sum,
                1.0 / 42.0
            )  # [42, n_ok]

            # 计算price_dev：收盘价偏差标准化
            c_mean = np.mean(c_ok_data, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, n_ok]
            c_std  = np.std(c_ok_data, axis=0, keepdims=True)   # [1, n_ok]
            std_ok = (c_std > 1e-10).squeeze(axis=0)             # [n_ok]

            price_dev = np.where(
                c_std > 1e-10,
                (c_ok_data - c_mean) / c_std,
                0.0
            )  # [42, n_ok]

            # Pearson相关：amo_ratio与price_dev
            # corr = (sum((x-x_mean)*(y-y_mean))) / (std_x * std_y * N)

            pd_c = price_dev - pd_mean  # [42, n_ok]

            pd_std = np.sqrt(np.mean(pd_c ** 2, axis=0))  # [n_ok]

        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return

        # 计算每天的条件加速度均值差
        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            if not np.any(close_valid[i]):
                continue

            acc_i  = accel[i]     # [40, n_valid]
            up_i   = up_mask[i]   # [40, n_valid]
            down_i = down_mask[i] # [40, n_valid]

            # 计算up条件下的加速度均值
            up_count   = np.sum(up_i,   axis=0).astype(np.float64)   # [n_valid]
            down_count = np.sum(down_i, axis=0).astype(np.float64)   # [n_valid]

            up_sum   = np.nansum(np.where(up_i,   acc_i, 0.0), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            down_sum = np.nansum(np.where(down_i, acc_i, 0.0), axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            up_mean   = np.where(up_count   > 2, up_sum   / up_count,   np.nan)  # [n_valid]
            down_mean = np.where(down_count > 2, down_sum / down_count, np.nan)  # [n_valid]

            # 条件加速度不对称性：up_mean - down_mean
            # 两者都有效时才计算
            valid_both = np.isfinite(up_mean) & np.isfinite(down_mean) & close_valid[i]
            stat_i = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
            stat_i[valid_both] = up_mean[valid_both] - down_mean[valid_both]
            daily_stat[i] = stat_i

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        weights = np.array([self.decay ** (L - 1 - i) for i in range(L)], dtype=np.float64)
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)             # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)    # [n_valid]

        w = weights[:, np.newaxis]                       # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w * valid_mask.astype(np.float64), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)        # [n_valid]

        mean_stat = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean_stat[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面 z-score 取负
        finite = np.isfinite(mean_stat)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return
        vals = mean_stat[finite]
        mu_x  = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return

        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals - mu_x) / std_x  # 截面z-score取负
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoPermutationEntropy(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大
        decay = 0.9
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        # 排列熵参数：embedding dimension m=3，共 42-2=40 个3元组
        # 3元素排列共有 3!=6 种模式：(0,1,2),(0,2,1),(1,0,2),(1,2,0),(2,0,1),(2,1,0)
        # 预计算模式索引：将3元组转换为0-5的整数索引
        # 排列(a,b,c)的秩：用argsort的字典序编号
        self._m = 3
        self._n_patterns = 6  # 3! = 6
        self._n_triplets = 42 - self._m + 1  # 40
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)

    @staticmethod
    def _perm_entropy(x):
        """
        计算序列 x 的排列熵，x shape: [n_bars, n_valid]
        m=3，对每列独立计算，返回 shape [n_valid]
        """
        n_bars, n_valid = x.shape
        m = 3
        n_triplets = n_bars - m + 1  # 40
        n_patterns = 6  # 3!
        # 累积各模式计数，shape: [n_patterns, n_valid]
        counts = np.zeros((n_patterns, n_valid), dtype=np.float64)
        # 枚举所有3元组
        for i in range(n_triplets):
            seg = x[i:i+m, :]  # shape [3, n_valid]
            # 计算每列的argsort，shape [3, n_valid]
            ranks = np.argsort(seg, axis=0)  # argsort: 0=最小索引
            # 将rank[0], rank[1], rank[2] 编码为0-5的整数
            # 用Lehmer编码或直接映射
            r0 = ranks[0]  # shape [n_valid]
            r1 = ranks[1]
            r2 = ranks[2]
            # 3个rank各为0,1,2的一个排列，编码为：
            # (0,1,2)->0, (0,2,1)->1, (1,0,2)->2, (1,2,0)->3, (2,0,1)->4, (2,1,0)->5
            # 等价于 r0*4 + ... 但更安全用字典映射
            # Lehmer码：idx = r0*2 + (r1>r2的修正)
            # 实际上对3元素的所有6种排列做完整枚举：
            # idx = r0*(m-1) + int(r1 > r2)  -- 这是Lehmer编码的简化
            # 但为避免分支，用向量化：
            # 6种排列及其编码:
            # (0,1,2)->0, (0,2,1)->1, (1,0,2)->2, (1,2,0)->3, (2,0,1)->4, (2,1,0)->5
            # 等价于：idx = r0*2 + (r2<r1 if r0==0 else (r2<r0 if r1==0 else 1))
            # 最简单向量化：idx = r0*2 + (r1 > r2).astype(int)
            # 验证：(0,1,2): 0*2+0=0✓, (0,2,1): 0*2+1=1✓
            #       (1,0,2): 1*2+0=2✓, (1,2,0): 1*2+1=3✓
            #       (2,0,1): 2*2+0=4✓, (2,1,0): 2*2+1=5✓
            idx = r0 * 2 + (r1 > r2).astype(np.int32)  # shape [n_valid], range [0,5]
            # 累积计数
            for p in range(n_patterns):
                counts[p] += (idx == p).astype(np.float64)
        # 归一化为概率
        total = counts.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)  # shape [1, n_valid]
        total = np.where(total > 0, total, 1.0)
        prob = counts / total  # shape [n_patterns, n_valid]
        # Shannon熵：-sum(p*log(p))，忽略p=0
        log_prob = np.where(prob > 1e-12, np.log(prob + 1e-12), 0.0)
        entropy = -np.sum(prob * log_prob, axis=0)  # shape [n_valid]
        # 归一化到 [0, 1]：最大熵 = log(6)
        max_entropy = np.log(float(n_patterns))
        entropy_norm = entropy / (max_entropy + 1e-12)
        return entropy_norm

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取过去lookback天的5m成交额数据，有效bar索引1:43，共42根
        # shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_raw = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :]  # [L, 42, n_stocks]
        amo_valid = amo_raw[:, :, valid_idx]           # [L, 42, n_valid]

        # 归一化：每天每股的amo_ratio = amo / (全天均值 + eps)
        # shape: [L, n_valid]
        daily_mean = amo_valid.mean(axis=1)  # [L, n_valid]
        daily_mean = np.where(daily_mean > 1e-8, daily_mean, 1.0)
        # amo_ratio shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_ratio = amo_valid / daily_mean[:, np.newaxis, :]  # [L, 42, n_valid]

        # 对每天、每只股票计算排列熵
        # 逐天计算以节省内存，shape结果: [L, n_valid]
        pe_daily = np.zeros((L, n_valid), dtype=np.float64)
        for d in range(L):
            x_d = amo_ratio[d, :, :]  # shape [42, n_valid]
            pe_daily[d, :] = self._perm_entropy(x_d)  # shape [n_valid]

        # 有效日掩码：当天amo均值>0
        valid_days = (amo_valid.mean(axis=1) > 1e-8)  # [L, n_valid]

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        # weights shape: [L, 1]
        w = self._weights[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        wtd_sum = np.sum(w * valid_days * pe_daily, axis=0)   # [n_valid]
        wtd_cnt = np.sum(w * valid_days,              axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        wtd_cnt = np.where(wtd_cnt > 1e-12, wtd_cnt, np.nan)
        signal = wtd_sum / wtd_cnt  # [n_valid]，值域[0,1]

        # 截面z-score
        finite_mask = np.isfinite(signal)
        n_finite = int(np.sum(finite_mask))
        if n_finite < self.min_valid_days:
            return
        mu  = np.nanmean(signal)
        std = np.nanstd(signal)
        if std < 1e-10:
            return
        zscore = (signal - mu) / std  # [n_valid]

        # 排列熵高（混乱无序）= 散户主导，趋于均值回归 -> 取负
        # 排列熵低（有序结构）= 机构按计划执行，趋于延续 -> 取正
        # 输出：低熵（有序）= 正信号（动量），高熵（无序）= 负信号（反转）
        pos = np.where(valid_idx)[0]  # 有效股票的全局索引
        for i in range(n_valid):
            if np.isfinite(zscore[i]):
                self.alpha[di, pos[i]] = -zscore[i]  # 高熵反转，低熵动量，取负

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoTimeSpearman(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大
        decay = 0.9
        w = np.array([decay ** (self.lookback - 1 - i) for i in range(self.lookback)], dtype=np.float64)
        self._weights = w / w.sum()  # shape [lookback]
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)

        # 预计算时间序号的rank（已排好序，rank=0..41）
        # Spearman相关 = Pearson(rank_x, rank_y)
        # 时间序号 t = [0,1,...,41]，rank就是自身
        # 预计算中心化后的时间rank向量，用于Pearson计算
        n_bars = 42
        t_rank = np.arange(n_bars, dtype=np.float64)  # [0, 1, ..., 41]
        t_mean = t_rank.mean()  # 20.5
        t_centered = t_rank - t_mean  # shape [42]
        t_std = np.sqrt(np.mean(t_centered ** 2))  # scalar
        self._t_centered = t_centered  # shape [42]
        self._t_std = t_std  # scalar

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取5m成交额数据，shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        amo_w = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)

        # 计算每天的Spearman相关系数
        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            amo_day = amo_w[i]  # shape [42, n_valid]

            # 检查有效性：所有bar成交额必须>0
            valid_day = np.all(np.isfinite(amo_day) & (amo_day > 0), axis=0)  # shape [n_valid]

            if not np.any(valid_day):
                continue

            nv = int(np.sum(valid_day))
            amo_valid = amo_day[:, valid_day]  # shape [42, nv]

            # 计算amo的日内rank（对42个bar按大小排序，得到rank序列）
            # argsort(argsort(x)) = rank（0-based）
            # 对每只股票单独排rank
            # argsort along axis=0
            sorted_idx = np.argsort(amo_valid, axis=0)  # shape [42, nv]
            amo_rank = np.argsort(sorted_idx, axis=0).astype(np.float64)  # shape [42, nv]，rank 0..41

            # Pearson(amo_rank, t_rank) = Spearman(amo, t)
            # t_centered shape [42], amo_rank_centered shape [42, nv]
            amo_rank_mean = np.mean(amo_rank, axis=0, keepdims=True)  # [1, nv]
            amo_rank_centered = amo_rank - amo_rank_mean  # [42, nv]

            # Pearson分子：sum(t_centered * amo_rank_centered)
            numerator = np.sum(self._t_centered[:, np.newaxis] * amo_rank_centered, axis=0)  # [nv]

            # Pearson分母：std(t) * std(amo_rank) * n
            amo_rank_std = np.sqrt(np.mean(amo_rank_centered ** 2, axis=0))  # [nv]
            denom = self._t_std * amo_rank_std * 42.0  # [nv]

            spearman = np.full(nv, np.nan)
            ok = (denom > 1e-10) & np.isfinite(numerator)
            spearman[ok] = numerator[ok] / denom[ok]

            daily_stat[i, valid_day] = spearman

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        w = self._weights  # shape [L]
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)  # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        w_col = w[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w_col * valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w_col * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面z-score取负
        finite = np.isfinite(mean)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return
        vals = mean[finite]
        mu_x = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return
        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals - mu_x) / std_x
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoDayPatternStabilitySlope(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 需要 lookback 天数据，产生 lookback-1 个相邻日对
        # OLS斜率投影向量：对 lookback-1 个相似度值
        L = self.lookback - 1  # 相邻日对数量
        t = np.arange(L, dtype=np.float64)  # [0, 1, ..., L-1]
        t_mean = t.mean()
        t_denom = np.sum((t - t_mean) ** 2)
        # OLS斜率投影：shape [L]
        self._slope_proj = (t - t_mean) / (t_denom + 1e-12)
        self._L = L
        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 3)

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self._L  # lookback - 1 个相邻日对

        # 取过去lookback天的amo数据，有效bar索引1:43（共42根）
        # amo_5m shape: [days, 49, n_stocks]
        # 取 [start:day+1, 1:43, valid_idx]，shape: [lookback, 42, n_valid]
        amo_window = self.amo_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)
        # shape: [lookback, 42, n_valid]

        # 对每天计算amo_ratio（归一化各bar成交额，使每天的42根和为1）
        # 这样跨日余弦相似度才有可比性
        daily_sum = amo_window.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)  # [lookback, 1, n_valid]
        daily_sum = np.where(daily_sum <= 0, 1.0, daily_sum)
        amo_ratio = amo_window / daily_sum  # [lookback, 42, n_valid]，每天和为1

        # 计算相邻两天的amo_ratio向量余弦相似度
        # amo_ratio[t] vs amo_ratio[t+1]，共 L = lookback-1 个对
        v1 = amo_ratio[:L, :, :]   # [L, 42, n_valid]
        v2 = amo_ratio[1:, :, :]   # [L, 42, n_valid]

        # 内积：sum over bar axis
        dot = (v1 * v2).sum(axis=1)   # [L, n_valid]
        norm1 = np.sqrt((v1 ** 2).sum(axis=1))   # [L, n_valid]
        norm2 = np.sqrt((v2 ** 2).sum(axis=1))   # [L, n_valid]
        denom = norm1 * norm2
        denom = np.where(denom <= 1e-12, 1e-12, denom)
        cosine_sim = dot / denom  # [L, n_valid]，范围 [0, 1]（amo_ratio非负）

        # 对相似度序列做OLS斜率（沿时间轴，axis=0）
        # slope[stock] = sum_t( (t - t_mean) * cosine_sim[t, stock] ) / t_denom
        # slope_proj shape: [L]，cosine_sim shape: [L, n_valid]
        slope = (self._slope_proj[:, np.newaxis] * cosine_sim).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        # 斜率为正=模式越来越稳定（机构按节奏执行），趋于继续；
        # 斜率为负=模式在瓦解（资金行为突变），次日不确定性高
        # 这里直接输出斜率（正值=稳定趋势，可能动量；负值=不稳定，可能反转）
        # 截面z-score标准化
        mean_val = np.mean(slope)
        std_val  = np.std(slope)
        if std_val < 1e-10:
            return
        zscore = (slope - mean_val) / std_val

        # 截断极值
        zscore = np.clip(zscore, -3.0, 3.0)

        # 写入 alpha：模式稳定性上升的股票（slope大）趋于动量延续，取正
        # 但为了与历史上反转类因子互补，我们取负（模式瓦解=短期超买，次日回撤）
        pos = np.where(valid_idx)[0]
        for i in range(n_valid):
            self.alpha[di][pos[i]] = -float(zscore[i])

from gsim import DataRegistry as dr
from gsim import AlphaBase
import numpy as np

class AlphaHwangAmoCondDirBias(AlphaBase):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        AlphaBase.__init__(self, cfg)
        self.daily_vol = dr.getData('volume').data           # [days, n_stocks]
        self.open_5m   = dr.getData('Interval5m.open').data  # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        self.close_5m  = dr.getData('Interval5m.close').data # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        self.amo_5m    = dr.getData('Interval5m.amo').data   # [days, 49, n_stocks]
        try:
            self.lookback = int(cfg.getAttributeDefault('lookback', 20))
        except:
            self.lookback = 20
        # 指数衰减权重，最近一天权重最大
        half_life = 10.0
        decay_arr = np.exp(-np.log(2) / half_life * np.arange(self.lookback - 1, -1, -1))
        self._decay = decay_arr / decay_arr.sum()  # shape [lookback]

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取5m数据，shape: [L, 42, n_valid]
        open_w  = self.open_5m[start:day+1,  1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)
        close_w = self.close_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)
        amo_w   = self.amo_5m[start:day+1,   1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)

        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            o_i   = open_w[i]   # [42, n_valid]
            c_i   = close_w[i]  # [42, n_valid]
            amo_i = amo_w[i]    # [42, n_valid]

            # 有效性检查：open>0, close>0, amo>0
            bar_valid = (o_i > 1e-10) & (c_i > 1e-10) & (amo_i > 0) & np.isfinite(o_i) & np.isfinite(c_i) & np.isfinite(amo_i)
            # shape: [42, n_valid], bool

            # 日总成交额
            amo_sum = np.where(bar_valid, amo_i, 0.0).sum(axis=0)  # [n_valid]
            # 避免除0
            amo_sum_safe = np.where(amo_sum > 1e-10, amo_sum, np.nan)  # [n_valid]

            # amo_ratio: 各bar成交额 / 全天总成交额
            amo_ratio = amo_i / amo_sum_safe[np.newaxis, :]  # [42, n_valid]，不足处为nan
            # 无效bar的amo_ratio置nan
            amo_ratio = np.where(bar_valid, amo_ratio, np.nan)

            # bar方向：close > open 为上涨(1)，close < open 为下跌(-1)，否则0（不参与计算）
            bar_ret = c_i - o_i  # [42, n_valid]
            is_up   = bar_valid & (bar_ret > 0)  # [42, n_valid]
            is_down = bar_valid & (bar_ret < 0)  # [42, n_valid]

            # 上涨bar的amo_ratio均值
            up_amo   = np.where(is_up,   amo_ratio, np.nan)  # [42, n_valid]
            down_amo = np.where(is_down, amo_ratio, np.nan)  # [42, n_valid]

            up_count   = np.sum(is_up,   axis=0).astype(np.float64)   # [n_valid]
            down_count = np.sum(is_down, axis=0).astype(np.float64)   # [n_valid]

            up_mean   = np.nansum(up_amo,   axis=0) / np.where(up_count   > 0, up_count,   np.nan)  # [n_valid]
            down_mean = np.nansum(down_amo, axis=0) / np.where(down_count > 0, down_count, np.nan)  # [n_valid]

            # 条件均值差：上涨时段 - 下跌时段
            diff = up_mean - down_mean  # [n_valid]

            # 只有上涨和下跌bar都充足时才有效（各至少5根）
            ok = (up_count >= 5) & (down_count >= 5) & np.isfinite(diff)
            daily_stat[i] = np.where(ok, diff, np.nan)

        # 指数衰减加权均值
        weights = self._decay  # shape [L]
        valid_mask = np.isfinite(daily_stat)  # [L, n_valid]
        valid_days_count = np.sum(valid_mask, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        w = weights[:, np.newaxis]  # [L, 1]
        w_sum = np.sum(w * valid_mask.astype(np.float64), axis=0)  # [n_valid]
        s_sum = np.nansum(w * daily_stat, axis=0)  # [n_valid]

        mean = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        min_valid = max(5, self.lookback // 4)
        enough = (valid_days_count >= min_valid) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]

        # 截面z-score，去极值（mean±3*std截断）
        finite = np.isfinite(mean)
        if int(np.sum(finite)) < 10:
            return

        vals = mean[finite]
        mu_x  = np.mean(vals)
        std_x = np.std(vals)
        if std_x < 1e-10:
            return

        # 去极值
        lo = mu_x - 3.0 * std_x
        hi = mu_x + 3.0 * std_x
        vals_clip = np.clip(vals, lo, hi)
        mu2  = np.mean(vals_clip)
        std2 = np.std(vals_clip)
        if std2 < 1e-10:
            return

        out = np.full(n_valid, np.nan)
        out[finite] = -(vals_clip - mu2) / std2  # 取负：追涨强→次日反转
        self.alpha[valid_idx] = out

        # 每组bar数量：42根二等分，各21根
        self._n_half = 21
        self._n_bars = 42

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))

        # 取5m数据：shape [L, 42, n_valid]
        open_w  = self.open_5m[start:day+1,  1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)  # [L, 42, n_valid]

        amo_w   = self.amo_5m[start:day+1,   1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)  # [L, 42, n_valid]
        L = open_w.shape[0]

        # 计算每日统计量
        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan)

        for i in range(L):
            o_i   = open_w[i]    # [42, n_valid]
            c_i   = close_w[i]   # [42, n_valid]
            amo_i = amo_w[i]     # [42, n_valid]

            # 有效性检查：open > 0 且 amo > 0
            open_ok = o_i > 1e-10             # [42, n_valid]
            amo_ok  = amo_i > 0               # [42, n_valid]
            bar_ok  = open_ok & amo_ok        # [42, n_valid]

            # 每股检查：至少需要30根bar有效（保证两组各>=15根）
            n_ok = np.sum(bar_ok, axis=0)     # [n_valid]
            enough = n_ok >= 30               # [n_valid]

            if not np.any(enough):
                continue

            # bar内收益率: (close - open) / open，无效bar设nan
            bar_ret = np.where(open_ok, (c_i - o_i) / (o_i + 1e-10), np.nan)  # [42, n_valid]

            # 只对 enough 的股票计算
            enough_idx = np.where(enough)[0]  # 有效股票索引

            for k in enough_idx:
                amo_k   = amo_i[:, k]       # [42]
                ret_k   = bar_ret[:, k]     # [42]
                ok_k    = bar_ok[:, k]      # [42]

                ret_valid = ret_k[ok_k]     # [n_ok_k]

                n_k = len(amo_valid)
                if n_k < 10:

                n_half_k = n_k // 2

            return

        # 尾部bar数量：42根中取首尾各10% -> 约4根

        self.min_valid_days = max(5, self.lookback // 4)

    def generate(self, di):
        day   = di - self.delay
        start = day - self.lookback + 1
        if start < 0:
            return

        valid_idx = self.valid[di] & (self.daily_vol[day] > 0)
        if not np.any(valid_idx):
            return

        n_valid = int(np.sum(valid_idx))
        L = self.lookback

        # 取5m开盘价和收盘价：shape [L, 42, n_valid]
        open_w  = self.open_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)   # [L, 42, n_valid]
        close_w = self.close_5m[start:day+1, 1:43, :][:, :, valid_idx].astype(np.float64)  # [L, 42, n_valid]

        # 有效性检查：open > 0
        open_ok = open_w > 1e-10  # [L, 42, n_valid]
        bar_ret = np.where(open_ok, (close_w - open_w) / np.where(open_ok, open_w, 1.0), np.nan)  # [L, 42, n_valid]

        # 计算每日的条件尾部均值不对称统计量
        # 对每天每只股票：将42根bar的收益率排序，取top-k和bottom-k
        # 统计量 = mean(top_k) + mean(bottom_k)，上尾正下尾负
        # 正值：追涨冲击 > 追跌冲击（强势日）
        # 负值：追跌冲击 > 追涨冲击（弱势日）
        top_k = self.top_k  # 4
        daily_stat = np.full((L, n_valid), np.nan, dtype=np.float64)

        for i in range(L):
            r = bar_ret[i]  # [42, n_valid]
            # 检查每列（股票）是否有足够有效数据
            finite_count = np.sum(np.isfinite(r), axis=0)  # [n_valid]

            r_stock = r[:, valid_stock]  # [42, n_vs]

            r_sorted = np.sort(r_stock, axis=0)  # [42, n_vs]，升序，nan会排到最后
            # 注意：np.sort默认将nan排到最后（升序中nan在最大端）
            # 实际上np.sort不处理nan，nan会排到末尾
            # 使用 np.nan 处理：用nan-sorting
            # 先填充nan为极大/小值进行排序，再mask回来

            # 安全排序：用np.nanpercentile等效方法
            # 对每列，取前top_k个（最小）和后top_k个（最大）
            # 由于nan在sort后排到末尾，bottom_k从头取，top_k从尾取（但要避开nan）

            # 方法：argsort of each column（nan-safe via masked approach）
            # 简单方法：对每个股票分别处理
            cvars = np.full(n_vs, np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
            for j in range(n_vs):

                if len(col_finite) < 2 * top_k + 1:
                    continue
                col_sorted = np.sort(col_finite)  # 升序
                n_f = len(col_sorted)
                # 下尾CVaR（最小top_k根的均值）
                lower_cvar = np.mean(col_sorted[:top_k])
                # 上尾CVaR（最大top_k根的均值）
                upper_cvar = np.mean(col_sorted[n_f - top_k:])

                cvars[j] = upper_cvar + lower_cvar

        enough = (valid_days_count >= self.min_valid_days) & (w_sum > 1e-10)
        mean[enough] = s_sum[enough] / w_sum[enough]
